artworks.title: Inconvénient... des domestiques qui ont servi chez M. Duprez
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on newsprint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and a woman. The man is seated at a keyboard instrument, and the woman is standing behind him. Both have their heads tilted back and mouths open, as if singing. The man has short dark hair, and the woman's hair is pulled back. They are wearing 19th-century attire. The room has basic furnishings, with a picture frame on the wall and curtain impressions visible. The floor has a wooden texture.

artworks.title: Banks of the Tamise
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water in the foreground, reflecting light and shadows. Trees line the horizon, with faint outlines of buildings in the background. The style is detailed etching with fine lines depicting trees, water, and buildings. The color palette is primarily sepia tones. Closest to the observer are leafless and full-foliaged trees on the left, while the right side shows more distant trees and structures. The overall scene conveys a tranquil and quiet simplicity through detailed imagery and earth-toned shades.

artworks.title: The Early Ploughman
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon emphasizing the sky with cloud formations. Distant mountains fade into the background, and there are two oxen being guided by a farmer on a dirt path. A series of tall trees stand to the right, and a solitary figure is near the tree line. The image is monochromatic with dark and light shades creating contrast.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Abraham
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in gray and black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.3 x 12.2 cm (8 x 4 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a raised object with clouds in the backdrop. The image portrays a dynamic scene with a figure in mid-action, striking a powerful and dramatic pose. The figure is dressed in a flowing draped garment, and their stance suggests movement or force as they stand beside an ornate surface. The style is reminiscent of classical or Renaissance pen and ink illustrations, emphasizing strong contrasts and detailed line work that defines musculature and the folds of the fabric. The surrounding elements, possibly furniture and clouds, are rendered with the same bold line work, contributing to the image's dramatic intensity.

artworks.title: Elisha Watching Elijah in the Fiery Chariot
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Eva S. Dencker, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This drawing features a horse leaping out of cloud formations in the sky. Underneath, there is a figure rowing in a small boat with a bundle on their back. Another figure stands on the ground extending an arm upwards. The sky is filled with swirling clouds and enigmatic elements, with plants and foliage in the foreground. The artwork has intricate linework and a historical narrative style.

artworks.title: Woods Near a Village with Rabbit Catchers and Their Greyhounds
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Iola S. Haverstick in memory of her father, Eugene W. Stetson, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape sketch viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. Various elements are visible in the scene, such as a row of trees in the distance that hides the horizon. Two dogs are near a stream or puddle, with two figures standing nearby and holding long sticks. In the background, a herd of cows grazes. The sketch uses soft, flowing lines with graphite shading to capture the scene in a monochromatic color palette of shades of grey and black.

artworks.title: An Egyptian Stage Design
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Frederick G. Schab, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient architectural site with elaborate stone structures. The foreground features grand steps flanked by statues of mythical creatures and ancient figures. Beyond the steps are stone walls, columns, and pyramids in the distance. The painting portrays intricate details of the stonework and light and shadow play with a monochromatic color scheme of browns, beiges, and greys, creating a historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Murder Scene
artworks.medium: wood engraving printed in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Ryskamp, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures inside a cave. One figure on the left is holding a large club or stick, raised high, while two other figures on the right are in a defensive posture. The setting is rocky, with texture to suggest a natural cave environment. In the upper left section, there are simplistic items etched which may represent tools or artifacts. The drawing uses strong lines and cross-hatching for depth and shadow.

artworks.title: Scene in a Cave
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Ryskamp, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows swirling, cloud-like shapes and curving lines dominating the upper part, creating an abstract scene. In the center, a dark form with an arching silhouette resembles the outline of a mushroom cap or a bird. Below, a small figure reclines with a candle, casting light highlighting the surrounding forms.

artworks.title: Christ Trampling Satan
artworks.artist: Thomas Butts, Jr. after William Blake
artworks.medium: engraving in black on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Ryskamp in memory of Lessing Rosenwald, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a standing figure holding a bow and arrow over a reclining form. The image portrays a muscular figure standing prominently, draped in flowing garments, and holding a bow in their left hand while preparing an arrow with their right hand. The dominant figure gazes downwards toward a semi-reclined form at their feet. The setting suggests a mythical or allegorical scene, characterized by intricate line work and shading that highlights the figures’ physical forms and the dynamic flow of their garments. The piece employs fine, detailed line work to convey texture and depth, exhibiting a classical art style that emphasizes anatomical precision and compositional balance.

artworks.title: Conscience and the Recording Angel
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.2 x 16.9 cm (9 15/16 x 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Ryskamp in memory of Lessing Rosenwald, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a title page for a music collection titled "The Seraph." The image features an ornate title design with detailed, decorative typography, and a depiction of an angelic figure on the right side. The angelic figure appears with elongated wings, wearing a long, flowing gown, and holding a book or tablet. Above the angel, a cloud-like form is visible. Below the title, a smaller inset illustration shows a reclining person partially draped, holding a chalice. The overall presentation combines elements of religious iconography with classical references typical of period engravings.

artworks.title: The Bellman
artworks.medium: etching on japan paper, pasted to board
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Ryskamp in honor of Paul Mellon, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low, with distant mountains meeting a cloudy sky. In the middle, a small village is nestled among rolling hills, with smoke rising from a chimney. A hill and sparse trees are visible in the distance. The engraving features meticulous and dense brushstrokes creating intricate textures and contrasts. The color palette is mainly monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow. Closest to the viewer are figures and animals, including a person walking near a cart and sheep grazing.

artworks.title: The Lonely Tower
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Ryskamp in honor of Paul Mellon, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The view in the image is frontal, showing a serene landscape at night. The sky is filled with stars and a crescent moon on the right. A tower stands on the left. The etching style has intricate brushstrokes with an emphasis on texture and fine lines. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and deep browns. Two figures are seated in the foreground, and a winding path leads through the landscape.

artworks.title: Sheep at Noon
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14 x 23 cm (5 1/2 x 9 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Ryskamp in honor of Paul Mellon, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This image shows a pastoral scene with a flock of sheep in a landscape. A large tree shades the sheep. In the background, there are trees, fields, and a church steeple. The drawing style is detailed and uses precise lines for texture. It is monochromatic and uses varying line density for contrast. Other animals can be seen grazing in the distance. Overall, the image portrays a peaceful rural setting.

artworks.title: John Martin
artworks.medium: engraving in black on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Ryskamp in honor of Paul Mellon, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the chest up, facing forward. He is in a three-quarter view, looking slightly to the left. The man has a somber expression, with prominent eyes and a straight nose. His hair is styled in a long, wavy manner and covers his ears, reaching the nape of his neck. He is wearing a dark coat with a high collar and a white cravat tied around his neck. The background is plain. Below the portrait, text identifies the man as John Martin, Pastor of the Church Meeting at Keppel Street, London. The portrait is labeled as painted and engraved by I. Basire in 1817.

artworks.title: Bacchante
artworks.medium: woodcut on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Ryskamp in honor of Paul Mellon, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: A nude figure is depicted standing in a natural landscape, playing a flute. The scene shows the figure from the back, draped in a flowing cloth and windblown hair. The background features trees, foliage, hills, and stylized clouds in the sky. The drawing includes detailed line work and shading to emphasize the form of the figure and the surroundings.

artworks.title: Tower of a Fortified House [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kurt Meissner, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a rustic building with a tall tower in the central part. There is no distinct horizon line. The tower and trees suggest verticality. The building has a tiled roof and a balcony. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, giving a sense of texture, especially in the trees with green leaves. The color palette is subdued, with light grays and muted greens against a pale background. Two figures are sketched on the right side.

artworks.title: View of the Islands of Nisida and Capri
artworks.medium: graphite and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kurt Meissner, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon where land meets the sea. The horizon is near the upper third of the image, emphasizing the expanse. Hills and a coastal line are visible in the distance, adding depth. The sketch uses a light monochrome palette with brown and gray washes, loose brushstrokes for texture. Rocky outcrops and trees are depicted closer to the viewer, blending into the pale sky. Ink and graphite lines indicate fine details of vegetation and structures.

artworks.title: Corner of a Garden Court
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kurt Meissner, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a circular fountain positioned at the center, with stairs on the left leading upwards. A low wall surrounds the fountain, with various pots and a small garden structure on top. Pencil sketches depict foliage, stone, and water with broad strokes, creating a monochrome scene. Loose plant forms and structural elements in the background give the impression of a lush garden setting.

artworks.title: Windmill near Burg on Fehmarn
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a windmill in the distance. The horizon line is central, and a windmill stands slightly off-center to the right. The brushstrokes are bold and loose, creating abstract forms, especially in the clouds and landforms. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of dark black on a beige background, highlighting texture and shapes.

artworks.title: Fehmarn Girls
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on yellow paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures from the shoulders up, both facing slightly towards the right edge, with one in the foreground and the other partially obscured in the background. The figure in the foreground has distinct facial features prominently outlined, with wide eyes and a large smile, and straight hair cascading down. The figure behind also has outlined facial features with closed eyes and straight hair. They appear to be wearing loose-fitting garments with flowing lines, with no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is stylized with abstract shapes and curved lines that fill the space. The entire composition is rendered in a monochromatic color scheme of black on a yellow surface.

artworks.title: Fanny Wocke
artworks.medium: woodcut on blotting paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image includes sharp, angular lines and jagged shapes that converge and diverge across the canvas, forming a complex composition. There is a central focus resembling a human face with sections suggesting eyes, nose, and a mouth, set amidst chaotic patterns. Dark areas contrast with lighter segments, creating a play between shadows and light reminiscent of leaves or feathers. Various textures are present, some appearing smooth while others are rougher, contributing to an intricate landscape.

artworks.title: The Wife of Professor Goldstein
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on blotting paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a composition of interwoven shapes and angular lines creating an abstract visual impression. The design resembles fragmented pieces that could be interpreted as parts of a human face, with suggested eyes and a mouth formed by the meeting of lines and curves. The use of light and dark contrasts enhances the abstract nature of the image, akin to a collage or mosaic coming together to form a visage out of chaos.

artworks.title: Mountains with a Mountain Hut
artworks.medium: woodcut touched with black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a high horizon, bold swirling clouds, a steep mountain on the left, and a monochromatic color palette of black on a light background. Closest to the viewer is a small structure and a solitary figure on the right, with other mountain peaks visible in the distance.
